children: The US Dollar Index remained little changed at 102.3 on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged, reaffirming its commitment to bringing inflation under control.
However, policymakers offered no clear indication that another rate hike could be on the table at their next meeting in December.
The vote was not unanimous, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissenting and favoring a 25-basis-point increase.
The decision comes less than a week before the November midterm elections, amid widespread dissatisfaction with the economy.
Polling points to a competitive electoral environment, with Democrats holding an advantage in several key races.
Investors are now awaiting Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s press conference for further clues on the central bank’s policy outlook and the potential direction of interest rates in the coming months.

title: US Dollar Steady as Fed Holds Rates
